description: Combined LG AC diagnostic decision trees

nodes.text_en: Is the AC turning on and showing lights on the display?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC chal raha hai aur display par lights dikhai de rahi hain?

nodes.text_en: Which best describes the cooling issue?
nodes.text_hi: Cooling ki samasya ko kaunsa option sabse achha describe karta hai?

options.label: No cool air / Only warm air blowing
Air is slightly cool / Weak cooling
Room does not reach set temperature

nodes.text_en: Is the AC set to 'Cool' mode (Snowflake symbol) at 18°C with High Fan Speed?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC 'Cool' mode (Snowflake icon) par 18°C aur High Fan Speed par set hai?

options.label: Yes, already set to 18°C Cool mode

nodes.text_en: Is the air filter dusty or clogged with dirt?
nodes.text_hi: Kya air filter dhool ya kachre se bhara hua hai?

nodes.text_en: Did cleaning and drying the filter resolve the cooling issue?
nodes.text_hi: Filter ko dho kar sukhane ke baad kya cooling behtar hui?

nodes.text_en: Is the outdoor unit compressor and fan running smoothly without unusual humming or clicking?
nodes.text_hi: Kya outdoor unit ka fan aur compressor bina kisi ajeeb awaaz ke chal rahe hain?

options.label: Yes, outdoor unit is running normally
Outdoor fan stops frequently / humming sound
Outdoor unit is completely off / not starting

nodes.text_en: Is there ice or frost forming on the thin copper pipe or indoor cooling coil?
nodes.text_hi: Kya patle copper pipe ya indoor cooling coil par barf (ice) jam rahi hai?

options.label: No ice, just normal room air

diag_refrigerant_gas_leak.probable_cause: Low Refrigerant Gas (R32) due to Micro-leakage
diag_refrigerant_gas_leak.rag_query: LG AC poor cooling ice on coil refrigerant recharge
diag_refrigerant_gas_leak.technician_note: Conduct 300 PSI nitrogen leak test on indoor/outdoor flare joints. Braze leak, vacuum down to 500 microns, refill R32 by weight.

diag_capacitor_outdoor_fan.probable_cause: Outdoor Fan Motor or Starting Capacitor Failure / Low Grid Voltage
diag_capacitor_outdoor_fan.rag_query: LG AC outdoor fan motor humming capacitor replacement
diag_capacitor_outdoor_fan.technician_note: Discharge capacitor safely before testing capacitance. Measure voltage under compressor start load.

diag_compressor_pcb_failure.probable_cause: Inverter Compressor Drive / Outdoor Main PCB Failure
diag_compressor_pcb_failure.rag_query: LG AC outdoor unit not starting inverter board troubleshooting
diag_compressor_pcb_failure.technician_note: High voltage risk. Check DC Link voltage and IPM output to compressor U, V, W terminals.

diag_low_cooling_efficiency.probable_cause: Clogged Heat Exchanger Coils or Thermal Sensor Drift
diag_low_cooling_efficiency.rag_query: LG AC poor cooling room temperature sensor check
diag_low_cooling_efficiency.technician_note: Check indoor thermistor calibration at 25°C. Perform foam jet cleaning of condenser.

AC02.title: No Power / AC Won't Turn On

nodes.text_en: Does the AC display or any indicator LED turn on?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC display ya koi bhi LED light ON ho rahi hai?

nodes.text_en: Display lights up, but does the AC start blowing air when you press Power on the remote?
nodes.text_hi: Display par light aa rahi hai, par remote se power dabane par kya hawa chalu hoti hai?

nodes.text_en: Have you tried pressing the ON/OFF button on the AC unit itself (manual emergency switch under the front panel)?
nodes.text_hi: Kya aapne indoor unit ke panel ke andar diye gaye manual power button ko dabaya?

options.label: Yes, manual button also does not work
Manual button turns on AC (Remote failed)

nodes.text_en: Is the dedicated MCB (breaker) for the AC switched ON in your home's main distribution board?
nodes.text_hi: Kya aapke distribution box mein AC ka MCB switch ON hai?

options.label: Yes, MCB is in UP (ON) position

nodes.text_en: Is power available in other appliances connected to the same room or power outlet?
nodes.text_hi: Kya usi kamre ke baki switches aur appliances mein light aa rahi hai?

options.label: No, home/room power is totally out

nodes.text_en: Did the MCB trip down again immediately when you switched it ON?
nodes.text_hi: Kya MCB ko ON karte hi wo dobara turant trip (band) ho gaya?

options.label: No, MCB stayed ON and AC started

diag_severe_short_circuit.probable_cause: Dead Short Circuit in Inverter Compressor / Outdoor PCB / Power Cord
diag_severe_short_circuit.rag_query: LG AC MCB trips immediately short circuit safety troubleshooting
diag_severe_short_circuit.technician_note: DANGER: DO NOT ATTEMPT TO FORCE MCB ON. Disconnect power cord and megger test compressor windings to ground.

diag_internal_fuse_pcb.probable_cause: Indoor PCB Power Fuse Blown (3.15A/250V) or Varistor Surge Damage
diag_internal_fuse_pcb.rag_query: LG AC indoor PCB blown fuse surge repair
diag_internal_fuse_pcb.technician_note: Check input AC 230V at CN-POWER terminal. Test continuity of PCB fuse and primary SMPS transformer.

diag_pcb_surge_protection.probable_cause: PCB SMPS Power Supply Fault or Microcontroller Lockup
diag_pcb_surge_protection.rag_query: LG AC power shuts down immediately after start
diag_pcb_surge_protection.technician_note: Inspect 12V and 5V DC regulated rails on indoor PCB.

diag_power_socket_inspection.probable_cause: Loose AC Wall Plug / Burnt Isolator Switch Contacts
diag_power_socket_inspection.rag_query: LG AC power plug loose neutral wire test
diag_power_socket_inspection.technician_note: Verify 230V line-to-neutral and <2V neutral-to-earth at wall socket.

nodes.text_en: What do you see on your AC display panel?
nodes.text_hi: Aapko AC display panel par kya dikhai de raha hai?

options.label: Specific Error Code (e.g., CH 05, CH 38, HL, CL)

nodes.text_en: Which category does your displayed code belong to?
nodes.text_hi: Display par dikhne wala code kis category ka hai?

options.label: Compressor & Electrical (CH 21, CH 22, CH 23, CH 26, CH 27, CH 29)
Temperature Sensors (CH 01, CH 02, CH 12, CH 41, CH 44, CH 45, CH 46)

nodes.text_en: CH 05 indicates a communication breakdown between indoor and outdoor units. Have you switched off the AC MCB for 3 minutes and turned it back ON?
nodes.text_hi: CH 05 indoor aur outdoor unit ke beech communication error dikhata hai. Kya aapne AC ka MCB 3 minute ke liye band karke dobara ON kiya?

nodes.text_en: Did the CH 05 error disappear and normal cooling resume after the MCB power reset?
nodes.text_hi: Kya MCB reset karne ke baad CH 05 error hat gaya aur cooling shuru hui?

nodes.text_en: Which exact refrigerant/pressure code is shown: CH 38 (Gas Leak), CH 32 (Discharge Overheat), or CH 35 (Low Pressure)?
nodes.text_hi: Display par inme se kaunsa code hai: CH 38 (Gas Leak), CH 32 (Discharge Overheat), ya CH 35 (Low Pressure)?

nodes.text_en: CH 38 means low refrigerant gas detected. Is the AC blowing room-temperature or warm air instead of cool air?
nodes.text_hi: CH 38 gas ki kami ka sanket hai. Kya AC thandi hawa ki jagah kamre jaisi normal hawa fenk raha hai?

options.label: No, cools for a few minutes then stops

nodes.text_en: CH 32 indicates high compressor discharge temperature. Is the outdoor unit blocked by walls, debris, or dirty condenser fins?
nodes.text_hi: CH 32 compressor ke garam hone ka sanket hai. Kya outdoor unit ke paas dhool, parda ya hawa rukne ki rukawat hai?

options.label: Yes, outdoor airflow is blocked / dirty

nodes.text_en: After clearing outdoor unit blockage and allowing it to cool down for 15 minutes, did the error clear?
nodes.text_hi: Outdoor unit ki rukawat hatane aur 15 minute thanda hone ke baad kya error theek hua?

nodes.text_en: Which fan motor code is shown: CH 10 (Indoor Blower Fan), CH 06 (Outdoor Fan/Thermistor), or CH 67 (Outdoor BLDC Motor)?
nodes.text_hi: Kaunsa motor error code dikh raha hai: CH 10 (Indoor Blower), CH 06 (Outdoor Fan/Sensor), ya CH 67 (Outdoor BLDC Motor)?

nodes.text_en: CH 10 means the indoor blower fan cannot spin freely. Can you hear the indoor fan spinning or is it completely silent?
nodes.text_hi: CH 10 ka matlab indoor blower fan ghum nahi pa raha. Kya fan ki chalne ki awaaz aa rahi hai ya bilkul shant hai?

options.label: Spins briefly and stops with beep

nodes.text_en: Which inverter/compressor code is shown on display?
nodes.text_hi: Display par kaunsa inverter/compressor error code dikh raha hai?

nodes.text_en: CH 22 occurs when total AC input current exceeds safety limits. Are other heavy appliances (geyser, oven) causing home voltage drop?
nodes.text_hi: CH 22 tab aata hai jab AC ka current safety limit se zyada ho jaye. Kya ghar mein low voltage ki samasya hai?

options.label: No, grid power is steady at 230V

nodes.text_en: CH 23 means DC bus voltage dropped below 140V DC. Do you have a voltage stabilizer installed with the AC?
nodes.text_hi: CH 23 DC voltage kam hone par aata hai. Kya aapke AC ke sath stabilizer laga hua hai?

nodes.text_en: Which temperature sensor code is shown: CH 01, CH 02, CH 12, CH 41, CH 44, CH 45, or CH 46?
nodes.text_hi: Inme se kaunsa sensor code display par hai?

options.label: CH 44 or CH 45 (Outdoor Air / Condenser Sensor)

nodes.text_en: Which PCB / Overheat code is displayed?
nodes.text_hi: Kaunsa PCB ya Overheating error code aa raha hai?

nodes.text_en: HL code indicates High Water Level in the condensate drain pan. Is water overflowing or leaking inside the room?
nodes.text_hi: HL code drain pan mein paani bharne ka sanket hai. Kya kamre ke andar paani tapak raha hai?

options.label: No, just HL code on display

nodes.text_en: Is the code CL (Child Lock) or FL (Filter Cleaning reminder)?
nodes.text_hi: Kya display par CL (Child Lock) ya FL (Filter Clean) likha hai?

nodes.text_en: Did holding the Timer/Function button for 3 seconds remove the CL code?
nodes.text_hi: Kya remote par Timer/Function button 3 second dabane se CL code hat gaya?

nodes.text_en: Did cleaning the air filter and pressing Filter Reset clear the FL code?
nodes.text_hi: Filter saaf karke Filter Reset dabane se kya FL code hat gaya?

nodes.text_en: How many times does the power or timer LED blink repeatedly between pauses?
nodes.text_hi: Power ya timer LED light lagatar kitni baar blink (chamakti) karti hai pause lene se pehle?

options.label: 1 or 2 Blinks (Equivalent to CH 01 / 02 Temp Sensor)

nodes.text_en: Display shows Po (Jet Mode), Lo (<10°C), HI (>36°C), or Od (Outdoor Temp). These are normal status indicators. Would you like to return to standard cooling mode?
nodes.text_hi: Po (Jet Mode), Lo, HI ya Od normal status indicators hain, koi kharabi nahi hai. Kya aap standard cooling mode par aana chahte hain?

options.label: Yes, guide me to exit status mode
No, I suspect actual cooling problem

nodes.text_en: Let's perform a clean electrical reset: Switch off the AC MCB for 5 minutes, turn it back on, and start via remote. Does the error persist?
nodes.text_hi: Chaliye ek electrical reset karte hain: AC ka MCB 5 minute band karke wapas ON karein. Kya error code abhi bhi aa raha hai?

options.label: Error is gone and AC is cooling

diag_ch05_comm_failure.probable_cause: Communication Cable Fault or Outdoor PCB Communication Circuit Failure (CH 05 / CH 53)
diag_ch05_comm_failure.rag_query: CH 05 communication troubleshooting steps and PCB voltage check
diag_ch05_comm_failure.technician_note: Measure DC pulse voltage between Terminal 1/2 and Neutral. Check for loose terminal block screws or rodent-damaged wires.

diag_ch38_gas_leak.probable_cause: Refrigerant Gas Leakage / Insufficient R32 Charge (CH 38)
diag_ch38_gas_leak.rag_query: CH 38 refrigerant gas leak detection and vacuum recharge procedure
diag_ch38_gas_leak.technician_note: Pressurize system with Nitrogen to 350 PSI. Soap test flare joints and U-bends. Braze leaks, evacuate to 500 microns, weigh gas in grams per nameplate.

diag_ch32_discharge_fault.probable_cause: Compressor Discharge Pipe Overheating (>105°C) or Clogged Condenser (CH 32)
diag_ch32_discharge_fault.technician_note: Inspect discharge pipe temperature sensor and refrigerant subcooling. Pressure wash outdoor coil.

diag_ch35_pressure_fault.probable_cause: Low Pressure Drop or Electronic Expansion Valve (EEV) Blockage (CH 35)
diag_ch35_pressure_fault.rag_query: CH 35 low pressure sensor fault fix
diag_ch35_pressure_fault.technician_note: Verify EEV coil pulse signals and suction operating pressure.

diag_ch06_outdoor_fan_sensor.probable_cause: Outdoor Pipe Sensor Open/Short or Outdoor Fan Motor Stalled (CH 06)
diag_ch06_outdoor_fan_sensor.rag_query: CH 06 outdoor sensor and fan motor diagnostic
diag_ch06_outdoor_fan_sensor.technician_note: Measure outdoor pipe sensor resistance. Test outdoor fan motor winding continuity.

diag_ch10_indoor_motor_lock.probable_cause: Indoor BLDC Blower Motor Locked or Casing Obstruction (CH 10)
diag_ch10_indoor_motor_lock.rag_query: CH 10 indoor blower fan motor lock troubleshooting
diag_ch10_indoor_motor_lock.technician_note: Inspect for physical obstruction. Check motor shaft bearing play and Hall sensor feedback pulses on CN-MOTOR connector.

diag_ch10_hall_sensor_fault.probable_cause: Indoor Fan Motor Hall Sensor IC Failure (CH 10)
diag_ch10_hall_sensor_fault.rag_query: CH 10 Hall sensor feedback circuit check
diag_ch10_hall_sensor_fault.technician_note: Check 5V DC supply and feedback pulse on PCB connector while rotating blower wheel by hand.

diag_ch67_outdoor_motor_lock.probable_cause: Outdoor BLDC Fan Motor Overcurrent / Rotor Lock (CH 67)
diag_ch67_outdoor_motor_lock.rag_query: CH 67 outdoor BLDC motor lock repair
diag_ch67_outdoor_motor_lock.technician_note: Check outdoor fan blade freedom. Measure U-V-W motor winding resistances (balanced approx 40-70Ω).

diag_ch21_ipm_overcurrent.probable_cause: Inverter IPM DC Peak / Compressor Overcurrent (CH 21)
diag_ch21_ipm_overcurrent.technician_note: High voltage risk. Check IPM diode resistance. Megger test compressor winding insulation to ground.

diag_ch22_voltage_strain.probable_cause: Input AC Overcurrent Due to Low Grid Voltage (CH 22)
diag_ch22_voltage_strain.rag_query: CH 22 AC input current limit low voltage fix
diag_ch22_voltage_strain.technician_note: Measure running AC current with clamp meter. If grid voltage dips below 190V under compressor load, install stabilizer.

diag_ch22_pcb_compressor_overload.probable_cause: Current Transformer (CT) Sensor Fault or Compressor Overload (CH 22)
diag_ch22_pcb_compressor_overload.rag_query: CH 22 CT sensor replacement and compressor load test
diag_ch22_pcb_compressor_overload.technician_note: Check Outdoor PCB CT sensor output voltage and cleanliness of condenser coils.

diag_ch23_stabilizer_needed.probable_cause: DC Link Under-Voltage Caused by Severe Low Input AC (CH 23)
diag_ch23_stabilizer_needed.rag_query: CH 23 DC link low voltage stabilizer requirement
diag_ch23_stabilizer_needed.technician_note: Check DC bus capacitor voltage (normal 310V DC at 230V AC input). Recommend wide-range voltage stabilizer.

diag_ch23_pcb_rectifier_fault.probable_cause: DC Bus Bridge Rectifier or DC Link Capacitor Degradation (CH 23)
diag_ch23_pcb_rectifier_fault.rag_query: CH 23 DC link PCB capacitor inspection
diag_ch23_pcb_rectifier_fault.technician_note: Discharge DC link capacitors safely before measuring resistance across bridge rectifier terminals.

diag_ch26_comp_start_fail.probable_cause: Inverter Compressor Drive / Starting Position Detection Failure (CH 26)
diag_ch26_comp_start_fail.rag_query: CH 26 compressor starting failure position detection
diag_ch26_comp_start_fail.technician_note: Check compressor U-V-W wiring harness. Check phase resistance balance (0.7Ω - 1.5Ω). If compressor rotor is locked, replacement required.

diag_ch27_pfc_fault.probable_cause: PFC (Power Factor Correction) Overcurrent / Reactor Failure (CH 27)
diag_ch27_pfc_fault.technician_note: Inspect PFC IGBT module on outdoor board and reactor continuity.

diag_ch29_phase_overcurrent.technician_note: Check for mechanical compressor overload or clogged capillary/EEV.

diag_ch01_room_sensor.probable_cause: Indoor Room Air Temperature Sensor (Thermistor) Open/Short Circuit (CH 01)
diag_ch01_room_sensor.rag_query: CH 01 indoor room thermistor replacement resistance test
diag_ch01_room_sensor.technician_note: Measure resistance with multimeter: 10kΩ at 25°C. Check for rodent bites on sensor wire.

diag_ch02_indoor_pipe_sensor.probable_cause: Indoor Pipe Temperature Sensor Open/Short (CH 02 / CH 12)
diag_ch02_indoor_pipe_sensor.rag_query: CH 02 CH 12 indoor pipe thermistor troubleshooting
diag_ch02_indoor_pipe_sensor.technician_note: Measure sensor resistance: 5kΩ at 25°C. Ensure firm contact with copper pipe pocket.

diag_ch41_discharge_sensor.probable_cause: Compressor Discharge Pipe Thermistor Sensor Error (CH 41)
diag_ch41_discharge_sensor.rag_query: CH 41 discharge pipe thermistor resistance specs
diag_ch41_discharge_sensor.technician_note: Measure thermistor resistance: 200kΩ at 25°C. Replace sensor assembly.

diag_ch44_outdoor_sensor.probable_cause: Outdoor Ambient / Condenser Pipe Thermistor Error (CH 44 / CH 45)
diag_ch44_outdoor_sensor.technician_note: Check outdoor thermistor assembly connector on Outdoor PCB.

diag_ch46_suction_sensor.probable_cause: Compressor Suction Pipe Thermistor Sensor Error (CH 46)

diag_ch09_eeprom_failure.probable_cause: PCB EEPROM Checksum Read Error (CH 09 / CH 60)
diag_ch09_eeprom_failure.rag_query: CH 09 CH 60 EEPROM error option code reprogram
diag_ch09_eeprom_failure.technician_note: Attempt remote option code entry per model service manual. If persistent, replace PCB.

diag_ch61_condenser_overheat.technician_note: Wash clogged condenser coil. Ensure minimum 30cm clearance around outdoor unit.

diag_ch62_heatsink_overheat.probable_cause: Inverter PCB IPM Heat Sink Overheating (>85°C) (CH 62)
diag_ch62_heatsink_overheat.rag_query: CH 62 inverter heat sink overheat thermal paste repair
diag_ch62_heatsink_overheat.technician_note: Apply fresh silicone thermal compound between IPM and heat sink. Check outdoor fan speed.

diag_hl_float_switch_tripped.probable_cause: Condensate Drain Pan Water Float Switch Tripped (HL)
diag_hl_float_switch_tripped.rag_query: LG AC HL code drain pump float switch troubleshooting
diag_hl_float_switch_tripped.technician_note: Clean sludge from indoor drain tray. Test drain pump electrical continuity.

diag_remote_control_service.rag_query: LG AC Child Lock disable without remote
diag_remote_control_service.technician_note: Test IR emitter output with phone camera. Replace remote if keypad non-responsive.

diag_unlisted_error_technician.probable_cause: Unidentified Hardware Fault / PCB Microcontroller Error
diag_unlisted_error_technician.rag_query: LG AC digital display error code technician troubleshooting manual
diag_unlisted_error_technician.technician_note: Inspect PCB LEDs, check supply voltage, measure thermistors, and check refrigerant pressures.

nodes.text_en: Where is the water coming from? Inside the room or outside?
nodes.text_hi: Paani kahan se aa raha hai? Kamre ke andar ya bahar?

nodes.text_en: Is the drain pipe bent, twisted, inclined upwards, or submerged in a bucket of water?
nodes.text_hi: Kya drain pipe muda hua hai, upar utha hai ya paani ki bucket mein duba hua hai?

options.label: No, pipe is straight and free

nodes.text_en: Is water dripping heavily like a stream, or only minor droplets forming on the casing?
nodes.text_hi: Kya paani tezi se dhaar ban kar beh raha hai ya sirf halki boondein tapak rahi hain?

nodes.text_en: Is it very humid or rainy today, and is water draining normally through the outdoor drain outlet?
nodes.text_hi: Kya aaj mausam bahut nam/barish wala hai aur outdoor pipe se paani nikal raha hai?

options.label: No, dripping from copper pipe joints

nodes.text_en: Did straightening the pipe and clearing the outlet stop the leak?
nodes.text_hi: Pipe seedha karne aur paani nikalne par kya leak ruk gayi?

diag_blocked_drain_tray.probable_cause: Clogged Drain Pan, Algae Sludge in Drain Line, or Dirty Air Filter
diag_blocked_drain_tray.rag_query: LG AC indoor water leakage clogged drain tray cleaning
diag_blocked_drain_tray.technician_note: Flush drain line with nitrogen or hand pump. Inspect drain pan cracks and verify proper fall slope.

diag_insulation_issue.probable_cause: Torn or Missing Thermal Armaflex Insulation on Suction/Liquid Copper Pipes
diag_insulation_issue.rag_query: LG AC copper pipe sweat condensation insulation repair
diag_insulation_issue.technician_note: Re-insulate exposed copper piping and wrap tightly with UV-resistant vinyl tape.

nodes.text_en: Are you noticing light mist/droplets (sweating) on the louvers or water streaming down?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC ke louvers/panel par halki boondein (sweating) hain ya paani beh raha hai?

options.label: Light droplets / Sweating on front louvers

nodes.text_en: Is the weather currently very humid, rainy, or is a window/door left open in the room?
nodes.text_hi: Kya aaj mausam bahut nam (humid) ya barish wala hai, ya kamre ki khidki/darwaza khula hai?

nodes.text_en: Is the AC running on Low Fan Speed with temperature set very low (18°C-20°C)?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC Low fan speed aur bahut kam temperature (18°C-20°C) par chal raha hai?

options.label: Yes, Low Fan and low temperature

nodes.text_en: Did switching to Monsoon (Dry) Mode or increasing fan speed stop the panel droplets?
nodes.text_hi: Dry Mode lagane ya Fan Speed badhane se kya boondein banna band hui?

nodes.text_en: Is the horizontal air louver angled straight down causing cold air to hit the lower casing?
nodes.text_hi: Kya AC ka flap bilkul neeche jhuka hua hai jisse thandi hawa body se takra rahi hai?

nodes.text_en: Is any water droplet or condensation reaching electrical sockets, power cords, or wiring?
nodes.text_hi: Kya paani ki boondein kisi power switch, taar ya socket tak pahunch rahi hain?

options.label: Yes, moisture is near electrical wires

diag_urgent_insulation_leak.probable_cause: Condensation Dripping Near Electricals / Damaged Internal Insulation
diag_urgent_insulation_leak.rag_query: LG AC condensation droplets near electrical wiring safety
diag_urgent_insulation_leak.technician_note: SHUT OFF POWER IMMEDIATELY. Inspect indoor backplate insulation and seal vapor barrier gaps.

diag_casing_insulation_gap.probable_cause: Internal Styrofoam Casing Gap or High Room Infiltration
diag_casing_insulation_gap.rag_query: LG AC front panel condensation sweating fix
diag_casing_insulation_gap.technician_note: Reseat front panel louvers and inspect internal EPS air duct insulation for cracks.

nodes.text_en: What type of smell do you notice coming from the AC?
nodes.text_hi: AC se kis tarah ki badboo aa rahi hai?

nodes.text_en: Is there any visible smoke, sparks, or is the burning smell intense?
nodes.text_hi: Kya koi dhuan, chingari ya bahut tezz jalne ki badboo aa rahi hai?

options.label: No smoke, just faint warm plastic smell on initial turn-on

nodes.text_en: When was the air filter and indoor cooling coil last cleaned?
nodes.text_hi: Air filter aur indoor coil aakhri baar kab saaf kiye gaye the?

options.label: More than a month ago / Dirty

nodes.text_en: Did cleaning the filter and running the AC on Fan Mode for 30 minutes eliminate the musty odor?
nodes.text_hi: Filter saaf karke 30 minute Fan Mode chalane se kya badboo khatam hui?

nodes.text_en: Does the odor smell like stagnant drain water coming from the indoor drain tray?
nodes.text_hi: Kya drain tray mein jama paani ya keechad jaisi badboo aa rahi hai?

nodes.text_en: Is this a brand new AC or first time turning on after winter season?
nodes.text_hi: Kya ye naya AC hai ya lambe samay baad pehli baar chalu kiya hai?

options.label: Yes, new AC or seasonal start

diag_burning_wire_motor.probable_cause: Burnt Terminal Block Wiring, Fan Motor Stator, or PCB Relay
diag_burning_wire_motor.rag_query: LG AC burning electrical smell safety hazard shutoff
diag_burning_wire_motor.technician_note: CRITICAL FIRE HAZARD: Disconnect MCB immediately. Check terminal block and motor windings for burnt insulation.

diag_drain_pan_mold_bacteria.probable_cause: Stagnant Water and Bacterial Algae in Condensate Drain Pan
diag_drain_pan_mold_bacteria.rag_query: LG AC musty smell drain pan algae cleaning
diag_drain_pan_mold_bacteria.technician_note: Flush drain line with disinfectant solution and verify slope of drain hose.

diag_evaporator_coil_foam_clean.probable_cause: Fungal & Mold Growth Deep Inside Evaporator Fin Pack
diag_evaporator_coil_foam_clean.rag_query: LG AC evaporator deep chemical foam cleaning
diag_evaporator_coil_foam_clean.technician_note: Perform high pressure jet wash with anti-fungal chemical foam on indoor evaporator.

diag_pest_in_blower.probable_cause: Deceased Pest or Insect Hive Inside Blower Housing
diag_pest_in_blower.rag_query: LG AC foul dead animal odor blower wheel removal
diag_pest_in_blower.technician_note: Dismantle indoor fascia and blower wheel to sanitize casing thoroughly.

diag_chemical_refrigerant_odor.probable_cause: Formaldehyde / Volatile Organic Compounds or Refrigerant Oil Mist Leak
diag_chemical_refrigerant_odor.rag_query: LG AC chemical vinegar sour smell evaporator leak
diag_chemical_refrigerant_odor.technician_note: Sniff test evaporator coil for formicary corrosion pinholes using halogen/ultrasonic leak detector.

diag_blower_motor_friction.probable_cause: Blower Motor Bush Bearing Friction Heating
diag_blower_motor_friction.rag_query: LG AC blower motor plastic friction smell
diag_blower_motor_friction.technician_note: Check rubber damper cushion on indoor blower motor mount.

nodes.text_en: What kind of noise is your AC making?
nodes.text_hi: Aapke AC se kis tarah ki ajeeb awaaz aa rahi hai?

nodes.text_en: Is the rattling coming from the indoor wall unit or the outdoor unit?
nodes.text_hi: Rattling ki awaaz indoor unit se aa rahi hai ya bahar wale outdoor unit se?

nodes.text_en: Is the front grill or air filter firmly snapped in place?
nodes.text_hi: Kya indoor front grill aur filter theek se band hai?

options.label: Panel is tight, noise is inside fan

nodes.text_en: Does the loud humming occur continuously when compressor starts or only at turn on?
nodes.text_hi: Kya tezz humming awaaz compressor start hote hi aati hai?

nodes.text_en: Is the gurgling/hissing heard during defrosting / right after turning off?
nodes.text_hi: Kya gurgling/hissing ki awaaz AC band hone ya mode badalne par aati hai?

options.label: Yes, brief sound after stop (Normal gas equalization)

diag_outdoor_mounting_unbalanced.probable_cause: Outdoor Stand Vibration Dampers Degraded / Loose Anchor Bolts
diag_outdoor_mounting_unbalanced.rag_query: LG AC outdoor unit shaking vibration pad installation
diag_outdoor_mounting_unbalanced.technician_note: Tighten mounting anchor bolts and place 20mm rubber vibration dampeners under outdoor unit feet.

diag_blower_wheel_debris_unbalance.probable_cause: Indoor Cross-Flow Blower Fan Unbalanced by Dust Clumps or Broken Blade
diag_blower_wheel_debris_unbalance.rag_query: LG AC indoor blower wheel rattling balance clip
diag_blower_wheel_debris_unbalance.technician_note: Inspect blower wheel balance weight clip and clean accumulated dust clumps from blade curve.

diag_bearing_wear.probable_cause: Motor Ball Bearing Wear in Blower Motor or Outdoor Fan Motor
diag_bearing_wear.rag_query: LG AC squeaking grinding bearing noise replacement
diag_bearing_wear.technician_note: Spin shaft by hand to check for radial play or grinding resistance. Replace defective fan motor.

diag_compressor_strain_low_voltage.probable_cause: Compressor Running Under High Load Strain or Low Operating Voltage
diag_compressor_strain_low_voltage.rag_query: LG AC loud compressor humming low voltage vibration
diag_compressor_strain_low_voltage.technician_note: Measure running voltage and current. Ensure condenser is free of obstruction.

diag_capacitor_contactor_buzz.probable_cause: Weak Run Capacitor or Chattering Magnetic Relay
diag_capacitor_contactor_buzz.rag_query: LG AC outdoor humming click not starting capacitor
diag_capacitor_contactor_buzz.technician_note: Test capacitor microfarad rating against rated spec.

diag_refrigerant_expansion_noise.probable_cause: Refrigerant Partial Restriction at Expansion Valve / Capillary
diag_refrigerant_expansion_noise.rag_query: LG AC hissing restriction EEV valve
diag_refrigerant_expansion_noise.technician_note: Check temperature differential across EEV / capillary tube.

options.label: Yes, remote screen is clear and active
No, remote screen is totally blank or faded

options.label: Yes, display turned on and AC works
Display turned on, but AC still does not respond
No, remote screen is still completely dead

options.label: Yes, camera sees purple flashing light (Remote transmits OK)
No light visible on camera screen

nodes.text_en: Does the AC beep or respond to any button on the indoor unit's manual emergency switch?

options.label: Yes, AC works via manual switch (IR receiver fault)
No response to manual switch either

diag_faulty_remote_hardware.probable_cause: Corroded Battery Terminals or Broken Remote PCB Crystal

diag_faulty_remote_ir_led.probable_cause: Damaged IR Emitter LED or Remote Keypad Membrane

Clean blower wheel, but fan spins slowly on high setting

diag_evaporator_coil_frozen.probable_cause: Evaporator Coil Choked with Ice due to Low Gas or Blower Failure

diag_blower_wheel_deep_clog.probable_cause: Indoor Blower Wheel Blades Choked with Dirt / Fungal Sludge

diag_blower_motor_capacitor_open.probable_cause: Indoor BLDC Blower Motor Failure / Blown Thermal Fuse
